svg.title: The table index convention, scope order and declared unused variables are part of the input. Let L be the total binary description length and let b bound numerator and positive-denominator bit length of each rational entry. For each tensor take the positive least common denominator qv of its entries, and set Wv = qvTv ∈Z2|Sv|, Q = ∏︂ v qv, Av = max |Wv|, B = 2N ∏︂ v Av.
